parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Centralize Hospital Administration'. Each LLG represents a distinct, documented function that the Administrator can perform within the system. The LLGs include registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time monitoring of hospital entities, all of which are essential for centralizing hospital administration.

The LLG 'Register Hospital in System' (llg_001) corresponds to the parent's requirement for registering a new hospital entity. The LLG 'Configure Hospital Settings' (llg_002) aligns with configuring hospital-specific settings. Similarly, 'Update Hospital Information' (llg_003) and 'Delete Hospital from System' (llg_004) cover updating and deleting existing hospital metadata, respectively.

The LLG 'Monitor Hospital Status' (llg_005) supports real-time operational monitoring, which is crucial for the Administrator to view the active/inactive status, resource availability, and performance metrics of hospitals. This capability ensures that the Administrator can effectively manage hospital data, resources, and operations.

No unsupported or misleading LLGs were identified, nor are there any essential capabilities missing from the provided decomposition.

Decision: KEEP_LOW_LEVEL_GOALS
